items.title: What Do U.S. Bancorp (USB) Leadership Changes And Global Funds Mean Now?
items.summary: U.S. Bancorp (NYSE:USB) reported leadership changes in its risk management and sales teams alongside an international fund platform launch. The firm announced the resignation of its Chief Risk Officer and new leaders for its Financial Institutions Group and Diversified Industries sales units. Management introduced U.S. Bancorp Global Funds, including an Irish domiciled liquidity fund aimed at offshore institutional investors. items.title: Why U.S. Bancorp (USB) Is Getting Fresh Attention
items.summary: U.S. Bancorp (USB) has put capital return back in focus. Management plans to restart share repurchases and ultimately return 70% to 75% of total capital through a mix of buybacks and dividends. Recent trading has been steady, with the 1‑month share price return of 5.84% helping U.S. Bancorp reach a year to date share price gain of 10.24%.
